description: Cedar Rapids, Iowa – Ashley Hinson’s campaign released the following statement and digital ad on Josh Turek’s radical record. Learn about it here: https://radicaljoshturek.com/. Chuck Schumer is on the ballot in Iowa – he goes by the name Josh Turek. Schumer spent nearly $10 million to get Josh Turek through the primary – more than he spent for any other candidate in the country – and it’s easy to see why: Every one of these positions has been repeatedly rejected by the people of Iowa, and Josh Turek will be too. In Washington, Turek would be a rubber stamp for the radical leftists who bankrolled his campaign. His values might fit in great in New York City with Chuck Schumer, but his liberal record won’t fly here in Iowa. ###
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ASHLEY FOR IOWA
title: Hinson Campaign Statement on Josh Turek’s Radical Record - Ashley Hinson for Iowa
